configurations.//: Pinned to 3020 on purpose, and strictly: apps/plans-explorer/app/vite.config.ts sets strictPort so a stale server makes this fail loudly instead of drifting onto the next free port — which is 3021, the landing. Do not move it: 3000 is the Hermes WhatsApp bridge, 3010/3011/3013/3015 are other local servers, and 5173 is usually claimed.
configurations.name: plans-explorer

configurations.//: Pinned to 3021. apps/site/ is plain static HTML with no build step, so it is served as bytes rather than through vite: what you see here is what nginx serves in production (see /Dockerfile). Bound to 127.0.0.1 so the landing is not published on the LAN.
configurations.name: site

configurations.//: Chat UI for the native Ollama daemon (llm/router.mjs's qwen3:14b, :11500) — a Docker container (ia-os-open-webui), not a process this pane starts or stops. Bring it up/down with `docker compose -f memory/docker-compose.yml up -d open-webui` / `down`; see memory/docker-compose.yml and llm/README.md.
configurations.name: open-webui
